entry_item.definition: [= bolγuzin (older form), dubitative forrn of bol-]. What if it will be or become?. I am afraid or worried that ...

example.unicode: ᠲᠣᠭᠲᠠᠭᠰᠠᠨ ᠬᠤᠭᠤᠴᠠᠭᠠᠨ ᠳᠠᠭᠠᠨ ᠲᠡᠭᠦᠰᠺᠡᠨ ᠦᠯᠦ ᠴᠢᠳᠠᠬᠤ ᠪᠣᠯᠤᠭᠤᠵᠠᠢ ᠺᠡᠮᠡᠨ ᠵᠣᠪᠠᠮᠤᠢ
example.transcript: toγtaγsan xuγucaγan daγan tegysken yly cidaxu -- kemen zobamui
example.definition: [I am] worried that [I or we] may not be able to complete [it] within the time limit.
